question: Which game won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2025 (the show held in December 2025)?
answer: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2025 [1]. It beat Death Stranding 2: On the Beach, Donkey Kong Bananza, Hades II, Hollow Knight: Silksong, and Kingdom Come: Deliverance II [1]. Polygon's 2026 coverage also names it as last year's winner [3].

keyPoints.text: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2025.
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 also won Best Narrative, Best RPG, Best Game Direction and Best Debut Indie Game that night.
Polygon describes Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 as last year's (2025) GOTY winner.
The 2025 show was held in December 2025, with nominees announced November 17 2025 ahead of a November 21 2025 cutoff.
